pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against adding to losing positions; multi-tier entries require confirmed structural break and positive unrealized buffer on previous tranche.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandatory ATR-based volatility cap and order-book imbalance check to block entries during high-impact spread widening and liquidity wicks.
profit_harvest_threshold: Scale out 50% of position at +$10.00 and lock remaining volume at breakeven plus trailing structural ATR.
